title: Estimate Geometric Transformation
text: 根据匹配点对估计几何变换，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Transformation type} 指定变换类型；{Find and exclude outliers} 查找并排除离群点、{Method} 查找离群点的方法 RANdom SAmple Con、{Algebraic distance threshold for determining inliers} 用于确定内点的代数距离阈值{Determine number of random samplings using} 使用以下项确定随机采样数 Specified val、{Number of random samplings} 指定随机采样数、{Desired confidence (in %)} 指定期望置信度（%）、{Maximum number of random samplings} 指定最大随机采样数、{Stop sampling earlier when a specified percentage of point pairs are determined to be inlier} 指定停止采样、{Perform additional iterative refinement of the transformation matrix} 指定执行额外的迭代细化、{Output Boolean signal indicating which point pairs are inliers} 输出布尔信号、{When Pts1 and Pts2 are built-in integers, set transformation matrix date type to} 指定变换矩阵数据类型、{Allow variable-sized signal input} 允许可变大小信号输入 也按实例取值；{Distance threshold for determining inliers (in pixels)} 用于确定内点的距离阈值，按实例取值。

params.name: Transformation type
params.values: 变换类型 Affine (default) | Nonreflective similarity | Projective

params.name: Find and exclude outliers
params.values: 查找并排除离群点 on (default) | off

params.name: Method
params.values: 查找离群点的方法 RANdom SAmple Consensus (RANSAC) (default) | Least Median of Squares

params.name: Algebraic distance threshold for determining inliers
params.values: 用于确定内点的代数距离阈值 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Distance threshold for determining inliers (in pixels)
params.values: 用于确定内点的距离阈值（以像素为单位） 1.5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Determine number of random samplings using
params.values: 使用以下项确定随机采样数 Specified value (default) | Desired confidence

params.name: Stop sampling earlier when a specified percentage of point pairs are determined to be inlier
Perform additional iterative refinement of the transformation matrix
params.values: 执行额外的迭代细化 off (default) | on

params.name: Output Boolean signal indicating which point pairs are inliers
params.values: 输出布尔信号 off (default) | on

params.name: When Pts1 and Pts2 are built-in integers, set transformation matrix date type to
params.values: 设置变换矩阵数据类型 Single (default) | Double

params.name: Allow variable-sized signal input
params.values: 允许可变大小信号输入 on (default) | off
